name: autovacuum_freeze_max_age
description: Maximum transaction age (in XIDs) before autovacuum is forced on a table to prevent transaction ID wraparound.
symptoms: Database shutdown due to XID exhaustion
Query failures with 'database must be vacuumed within N transactions'
tuning_tips: Set to a value significantly lower than the 2-billion-XID wraparound limit; reduce for tables with high transaction churn to avoid sudden wraparound emergencies, but avoid setting too low to prevent excessive autovacuum overhead.
